data.body: [P1] After `PENDING` or `RETRYING` is selected, this still waits indefinitely for the handler and its cleanup to return; invocation-end hooks are subsequently awaited without a deadline too. A blocked `finally` or hook can therefore consume the Lambda timeout and prevent the selected durable response from being delivered. Bound cleanup using the invocation’s remaining time, reserve finalization/response budget, and prevent abandoned handlers from issuing checkpoints. Add a low-remaining-time regression test.
